It starts with the tortilla

A good taco stands or falls on its tortilla. At Las Tarascas, the corn tortillas are homemade — soft, warm, and the start of everything on the menu.

They carry the tacos and the barbacoa, they roll into the enchiladas, and they puff up on the comal as gorditas.

  • Homemade corn tortillas at the center of the menu
  • Tacos, barbacoa, enchiladas, gorditas and quesadillas
  • In Oak Cliff, Dallas — open Tuesday to Sunday
